scope: monthly award emblems, five categories x three metals
postprocessing: None. Generated source PNG copied byte-for-byte into project.

color_policy.silver: neutral cool polished silver with RGB gray highlights/shadows; no green metal tint
color_policy.enamel: emerald/jade green plus ivory fixed in base assets; date palette is applied by parent rendering

inspection_summary.alpha: All assets have an alpha channel. Corner alpha values are 0 except prediction-gold bottom-left and victory-silver top-left, which are 1/255 (generated residual alpha). Original alpha is preserved.
inspection_summary.visual_review: All 15 assets inspected with view_image; no labels/dates/logos; all are single monthly award pins; metal colors visibly distinct.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production clan personal emblem game UI pin. Input image is a design reference sheet, not the output layout. Create a SINGLE isolated monthly award emblem matching the specified top-row concept of that sheet. Refined metal relief with glossy deep emerald/jade-green and warm ivory enamel; front-facing orthographic view; clean strong icon shapes readable at 64 pixels; polished sculpted collectible quality. A SHORT emerald-and-ivory striped ribbon hanger above the emblem, small diamond jewel linking hanger to main subject. MONTHLY VERSION: keep that short ribbon; do not add an annual surround, new outer laurel frame, crown, banner, decorative wings, plate or pedestal. Champagne gold metal borders and raised relief. All five monthly categories should be one coherent family. Square image, complete silhouette centered, about 12% empty transparent margin on every edge. Background genuinely transparent with clean alpha. No background color, texture, pattern or scenery; no ground, cast shadow, glow or drop shadow; no letters, dates, numbers, labels, logo or watermark. Do not produce a grid, contact sheet, variants or more than one emblem. Preserve the central subject from the reference without adding unrelated objects.
Reference: TOP ROW FIRST design, 01. Main subject is a trophy cup with a large five-pointed star on the green bowl, curved handles, slim stem and foot. Keep the two small laurel sprigs attached to the lower sides of the trophy, as in the concept; these belong to the trophy, not an added surrounding annual frame.
EDIT: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target. Preserve the identical monthly trophy-and-star award emblem design, gold metal, emerald and ivory colors, ribbon hanger, laurel sprigs, all shapes, arrangement and details. Change ONLY composition scale: reduce the entire pin uniformly to 76 percent of canvas height centered on a square transparent canvas, leaving 12 percent transparent empty margin above and below and ample transparent margin at both sides. Complete silhouette. Do not redraw, recolor or add anything. Genuinely transparent background, no shadow, no text, no date, no number, no logo.
